page: Microsoft Azure E4ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Eadv6 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 2 physical cores with 2 threads per core, supported by 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Local storage is provided via a 236 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance is Premium Storage capable.

Performance benchmarks reveal strong single-core capabilities, with stress-ng single-core CPU performance scoring 3080.18 and Geekbench single-core reaching 2103.0, both placing in the top 25%. Multi-core performance is moderate, with stress-ng multi-core scoring 6152.26 and Geekbench multi-core at 4846.0. Memory write bandwidth for large blocks is average at 27.94 GB/sec, though read bandwidth is weaker, registering 37.16 GB/sec for large blocks. The processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 vector extensions and cryptography acceleration, which assist in workloads like encryption, where it achieves average performance.

The E4ads_v6 exhibits a clear tradeoff between strong single-threaded execution and weaker multi-threaded scaling, as seen in its below-average multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and software compilation scores. Database operations and Redis SET performance are also positioned in the lower tier. However, its high memory density and solid single-core throughput make it qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-bound workloads that do not require massive parallel processing. It is well-suited for applications such as caching layers, light database hosting, static web serving, and small-scale language model inference.
description: Microsoft Azure E4ads_v6 is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual machine from the Eadv6 family, powered by a 3.7 GHz AMD EPYC 9V74 processor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs, 32.0 GB of RAM, and a 236 GB local NVMe SSD. Operating on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this instance delivers strong single-core performance, as evidenced by top-tier stress-ng and Geekbench single-core benchmark results. However, memory read bandwidth and multi-threaded scaling present performance tradeoffs, with weaker results in software compilation and database operations. The 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio provides qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not demand high parallel compute density. The E4ads_v6 is best suited for memory-bound applications, including caching layers, static web serving, and light database workloads.
